name: cursor-usage-status
description: Shows Cursor token-based plan spend against your monthly limit in the status bar. Unofficial; uses Cursor local auth and API.
author: Clear Measure Labs

cursorUsageStatusbar.apiBaseUrl.description: HTTPS base URL for Cursor usage API (Enterprise/proxy override).

cursorUsageStatusbar.displayFormat.description: Status bar text style. All formats show USD spend.

cursorUsageStatusbar.manualMonthlyLimitD.markdownDescription: Monthly spend limit in USD, used only when Cursor reports no per-user limit for your account (individual/Pro plans). Leave at `0` to show spend without a limit. Ignored when a team limit is available.

cursorUsageStatusbar.paceNotifications.description: Notify when spend is projected to exhaust the monthly limit before the cycle resets. At most one notification per escalation, and dismissing silences it for the rest of the cycle.

cursorUsageStatusbar.warningRemainingPer.description: Color warning when remaining spend allowance is at or below this percent of the limit.

cursorUsageStatusbar.criticalRemainingPe.description: Color critical when remaining spend allowance is at or below this percent of the limit.

cursorUsageStatusbar.includedModelKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: **Deprecated:** Cursor replaced per-model request quotas with token-based spend pricing, so there is no model bucket to select. This setting is ignored and will be removed in a future release.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run compile && mocha "out/test/**/*.test.js"
